Alger, 17 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 17, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The national robotics team won the gold medal at the FIRST Global Challenge 2026 held in Incheon. The group of five high school students stood out among participants from over 190 countries.
Distinction internationale pour l'équipe: International distinction for the Algerian robotics team
De retour en Algérie, la Team Algeria s': Back in Algeria, Team Algeria shone at the global event dedicated to science, technology, and robotics held from October 7 to 10, 2026, in Incheon. The delegation, composed of five high school students accompanied by a coach and a mentor, won the "Jackie Bezos Award for International Enthusiasm".
Dans le cadre d'un partenariat stratégiq: As part of a strategic partnership with Samsung Electronics Algeria, the young winners also undertook a study visit on October 12 to the National Fire Research Institute (NFRI). This trip allowed them to observe cutting-edge technologies related to fire prevention and risk management.
L'action a été menée conjointement avec: The initiative was carried out jointly with Altis Training Center. The Managing Director of Samsung Electronics Algeria, Johnny Jung, stated: "This gold medal demonstrates the power of aligning private sector strength with government vision to support youth in STEM and robotics." For its part, Altis Training Center emphasized that this success "raises Algeria into the top 20 of the global ranking for awards obtained at the FIRST Global Challenge."
